testimonialIntro: Real stories from real businesses. See how we’ve helped transform delivery, cash flow, and customer satisfaction for our partners across Morocco.
testimonial1: We scaled from 30 to 200+ orders/month thanks to their bulk shipping tools. What used to take 3 hours now takes 15 minutes!
testimonial2: Finding reliable COD delivery for rural customers was impossible. Now we ship to every corner of Morocco with the same confidence as city orders.
testimonial3: Before OneColis, I waited weeks for COD payments. Now I get paid the next day – my cash flow improved so much I could finally hire an assistant!
testimonial4: The customer support is top-notch. Whenever I have a question, they’re quick and helpful. Love working with them!
testimonial5: Deliveries are always on time, and COD processing is fast. Game-changer for small businesses like mine.
testimonial6: We doubled our monthly orders within 2 months of switching. The analytics dashboard is super useful too.
faqIntro: Have questions? We’ve got answers. Browse our most frequently asked questions to learn more about our services, policies, and how we support your business every step of the way.
faq1Q: How fast can you deliver COD orders across Morocco?
faq1A: Our smart routing delivers in 1-2 days (major cities) and 2-3 days (nationwide) – 40% faster than standard couriers. Casablanca sellers often see same-day delivery!
faq2Q: What happens if a customer refuses a COD order?
faq2A: Zero cost to you. We handle free return pickups and notify you immediately. Most refused parcels are back in your hands within 48 hours.
faq3Q: How quickly will I receive my COD payments?
faq3A: Next-business-day deposits to your bank account – the fastest in Morocco. Track every dirham in real-time via your dashboard.
faq4Q: Can I ship bulk orders from Shopify or Jumia?
faq4A: Yes! Automatically import orders from major platforms. Our system processes 100+ orders in under 5 minutes with bulk upload.
faq5Q: What makes your tracking better than competitors?
faq5A: Customers get GPS-powered WhatsApp/SMS alerts with live delivery windows (not vague 'out for delivery' updates). Sellers see exact driver locations.
